violated_contract: When SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is the customer-data runtime identity, Firestore must use that service account and its project_id for user-doc reads; host-project ADC, Workload Identity, or a compute-project GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT must not silently win.
canonical_prevention: Build the Firestore client through an explicit customer-data credential helper that loads SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON credentials and project_id (mirroring GCS), and keep behavioral tests that prove a host-project GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT cannot redirect the client when the JSON SA is set.
